security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, fenced examples, inline paths, relative fetch examples, HTTP status codes, and Mermaid documentation. No evidence found of command execution, external data exfiltration, prompt injection, or malicious instructions in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Markdown examples triggered static command and reconnaissance patterns.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that shell snippets are optional documentation examples and require normal user approval before execution.

content.value_statement: Documentation drifts when code, APIs, and agents change. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused updates for README, API, architecture, and changelog files.
actual_capabilities: Locate and review existing Markdown documentation files.
Update README sections for features, tech stack, installation, usage, and deployment.
Draft API endpoint documentation with authentication, inputs, responses, errors, and examples.
Create changelog entries using Added, Changed, Fixed, and Security categories.
Document architecture with Markdown diagrams and Mermaid examples.
Sync .claude/claude.md and .claude/agent.md after system or agent changes.
limitations: The guidance is tailored to Unite-Hub documentation conventions.
It needs repository context to identify accurate code and API changes.
It does not provide an automated documentation generator.
It assumes Markdown-based docs and TypeScript or Next.js examples.

use_cases.title: Refresh README after a release
use_cases.description: Update feature lists, setup steps, usage notes, deployment details, and links after a product release.

use_cases.title: Document new API endpoints
use_cases.description: Create endpoint references that cover purpose, authentication, request fields, response shape, errors, and usage notes.

use_cases.title: Keep architecture docs aligned
use_cases.description: Revise system diagrams, component summaries, data flows, and integration notes after refactors or new services.

prompt_templates.title: Update Basic Docs
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner update for a known change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the README for this feature change: [describe change]. Preserve the existing structure and mark any missing details.

prompt_templates.title: Document an API Endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Document the new endpoint at [route path]. Include purpose, authentication, request fields, response summary, errors, and a short usage note.

prompt_templates.title: Sync Project Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the recent changes and update README, API documentation, architecture notes, and the changelog where needed. List assumptions before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Documentation Drift
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across code and docs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the current documentation with the implemented code paths, agents, and integrations. Report stale sections and propose precise edits.

output_examples.input: A new contacts bulk update endpoint was added.
output_examples.output: Adds an API documentation section that explains the endpoint purpose, authentication, inputs, success result, error cases, and usage guidance.

output_examples.input: The dashboard gained a new analytics page.
output_examples.output: Updates the README feature list, expands the architecture overview, and adds a changelog entry under Added.

output_examples.input: Agent definitions changed after a workflow refactor.
output_examples.output: Refreshes the Claude agent file with updated roles, invocation rules, tool notes, and integration expectations.

best_practices: Provide the code change summary and affected files before asking for documentation updates.
Ask the skill to preserve existing headings, tone, and project-specific naming.
Review generated examples for accuracy before publishing documentation.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for broad documentation rewrites without describing what changed.
Do not accept placeholder endpoint details when the route behavior is available.
Do not publish generated examples before checking that names, routes, and versions are current.

faq.question: What documentation does this skill maintain?
faq.answer: It focuses on README files, API references, architecture notes, changelogs, and Claude agent documentation for Unite-Hub.

faq.question: Can it create API documentation from code?
faq.answer: It can draft endpoint documentation when it has route context, request details, response behavior, and authentication rules.

faq.question: Does it replace a documentation review?
faq.answer: No. Reviewers should still verify examples, routes, version numbers, and project-specific claims.

faq.question: Can it update changelogs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can format release notes with Added, Changed, Fixed, and Security sections.

faq.question: Is it specific to Unite-Hub?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions reference Unite-Hub files, agents, routes, stack choices, and documentation conventions.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
